title: api.response.v1
description: Phase 9 — emitted by the API gateway after the response is written. Carries outcome, timing, and cache state. bytes_out is computed on the actual response writer (gzipped if applicable) so the audit row is truthful. request_id round-trips from api.request.v1.

request_id.description: Unique id minted at gateway ingress; round-trips from api.request.v1.

status.description: HTTP response status code written to the client.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from accepted_at (api.request.v1) to final byte written.

bytes_out.description: Compressed bytes written to the client (post-gzip when applicable). Sourced from the response writer, not a Content-Length header estimate.

degraded.description: True when the response was served from a fallback or partial data path due to an upstream failure.

prediction_id.description: ID of the prediction record returned in this response. Absent when the route does not produce a prediction.

calibration_version.description: Calibration model version used to post-process the prediction. Absent when no calibration was applied.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code when status >= 400. Absent on success.
